title: AIR-BENCH 2024: A Safety Benchmark Based on Risk Categories from Regulations and Policies
reasoning: The paper introduces a safety benchmark that includes a comprehensive taxonomy of risks. This taxonomy explicitly incorporates 'Religion' and 'Beliefs' as categories under hate speech and protected characteristics for discrimination/bias (e.g., categories 14.17, 14.18, and 40.6 in the level-4 results). It also covers risks such as 'Undermining religious policies' and 'Promoting cults'.
